description: PDN Impedance Analyzer & Decoupling Capacitor Optimizer. Runs server-side on rftools.io as an async job. Time budget 360 s. Returns a summarised result; ask for full for everything. Cross-parameter checks: port_within_board, sweep_stop_after_start.

boardLength_mm.description: Board Length (mm). min 10, max 500. omit for the default of 150

boardThickness_mm.description: Plane-Pair Separation (mm). min 0.05, max 5. omit for the default of 1.6

boardWidth_mm.description: Board Width (mm). min 10, max 500. omit for the default of 100

dielectricEr.description: Dielectric ε_r. FR4 ≈ 4.5; Rogers 4350B ≈ 3.66; Rogers 3003 ≈ 3.0. min 1, max 15. omit for the default of 4.5

freqMax_hz.description: Freq Max (Hz). min 1000000, max 10000000000. omit for the default of 1000000000

freqMin_hz.description: Freq Min (Hz). min 100, max 1000000. omit for the default of 1000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

lossTangent.description: Loss Tangent. FR4 ≈ 0.020; Rogers materials ≈ 0.002–0.004. min 0.001, max 0.1. omit for the default of 0.02

maxCapCount.description: Max Decap Count. Total decoupling capacitor budget the optimizer may place. min 1, max 200. omit for the default of 30

portX_mm.description: Port X location (mm). Location where PDN impedance is evaluated (e.g. IC power pin). min 0, max 500. Omit to let the service derive it: board centre (boardWidth_mm / 2).

portY_mm.description: Port Y location (mm). min 0, max 500. Omit to let the service derive it: board centre (boardLength_mm / 2).

randomSeed.description: Random Seed. Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design. min 0. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

targetImpedance_mohm.description: Target Impedance (mΩ). Flat target impedance — keep Z_PDN below this across all frequencies. min 0.1, max 1000. omit for the default of 10

vrmBandwidth_hz.description: VRM Bandwidth (Hz). VRM control loop bandwidth — the VRM provides low impedance only below this frequency. min 1000, max 10000000. omit for the default of 100000

vrmDcr_mohm.description: VRM DC Resistance (mΩ). min 0.1, max 500. omit for the default of 5

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_pdn_impedance
title: PDN Impedance Analyzer & Decoupling Capacitor Optimizer
